note: The script asks for the hook text, the name super, one number pop (10 seconds) and one top text line (I made new friends.). The button is captions only. The end card is typed until the LearnFresh logo is in the repo.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: Math in silence? Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on. Top third. Out at 00:03. Name super at 00:03 for 2 s, lower left above the captions: Carla D. / 7th grade.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: Math in silence? Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on. Top third. Out at 00:03. Name super at 00:03 for 2 s, lower left above the captions: Carla D. / 7th grade.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:03 for 2 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line <7th grade> under it.

mg.title: Number pop
mg.cue: Number pop as she says it: 10 seconds, label on the clock. Top band, 2 s.
mg.use: Pop it at the moment she says “10 seconds” as it is said, top band, 2 s.

mg.title: Top text
mg.cue: Top text for 1.6 s before she starts: I made new friends. Top band.
mg.use: Put it on at the start of this row and hold 2 s, in the top band. Captions stay on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card lines: <q>Donate to Learn Fresh</q> / <q>learnfresh.org</q>. No logo before this card.
mg.src: No LearnFresh logo file in the repo yet (brand kit is in Airtable). The name is typed until the logo is added to endcards/learn-fresh/.
mg.use: This is the end card. Put it at 00:27 after the last line and hold it to the end.
